text: ITEM 1 | Pile of about 35-40 smooth, oval, tan-to-medium-brown pieces, roughly 2.5 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, with a matte, slightly dry surface and no visible oil or sheen. Pieces are firm and hold their shape, with a few lighter, paler patches and a small pointed tip on some. Heaped loosely in the center and lower-left of a white square plate, covering about 35-40% of its surface, with a few pieces scattered toward the right edge. | 45
